script:
export PATH=$PATH:/opt/mssql-tools18/bin
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
  sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P '${SA_PASSWORD}' -C -Q "SELECT 1" >/dev/null 2>&1 && break
  sleep 5
done
sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P '${SA_PASSWORD}' -C -Q "ALTER DATABASE DemoDB SET OFFLINE WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE;"
sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P '${SA_PASSWORD}' -C -W -Q "SET NOCOUNT ON; SELECT name, state_desc FROM sys.databases WHERE name='DemoDB';"
echo SCENARIO_3_TRIGGERED
